identity.lockedDescription: short chubby oval seed; flat 2D; thick outline; simple face; three-leaf sprout; rubber-hose limbs; white gloves and shoes; no costume, armor, cape or prop; no realistic shading
identity.resolution: Complete and approve SM-001 against the locked target identity before rebuilding the player animation batches. Do not silently treat the current armored showcase as the permanent mascot contract.

runtimeSystemFindings.finding: The authoritative runtime character contract is green-armored-plant-hero while the locked mascot construction requires the simple classic oval Seed Man with no costume or armor.

The production renderer provides only ten atlas cells total: six base action cells plus four phenotype cells. For non-plant phenotypes it selects a phenotype cell instead of preserving the full movement/action state family, so Fire/Electric/Ice cannot have complete run/jump/attack/hurt/victory animation coverage.

The approved art manifest exposes five world background keys as renderer contracts rather than authored world-art files. This satisfies a key lookup but does not satisfy the five required parallax world kits.
game.json reports 1 authored level and 19 generated levels. The campaign is live before the authored-level migration and final visual pass are complete.
Desktop browser playtest, mobile browser playtest and human final visual review release gates are false while the route is live.

Asset completeness and runtime release readiness are conflated. Existing production checks verify contract markers and file presence but do not prove that every planned visual family is authored and approved.
